claim_text: Probiotic effects are strain-, product-, indication- and outcome-specific; evidence for one strain or condition cannot be generalized to an unspecified probiotic product for generic digestive health.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: People considering probiotics for digestive health.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Probiotics fact sheet emphasizes strain-specific evidence and safety context.
limitations: No generic dose; exact strain and product must match studied evidence.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
